title: Shared rotation-code bank for low-bit Pythia KV caches
hypothesis: A four-entry shared codebook of exact orthogonal views can reduce the paid per-session int4 KV-cache payload versus independent role rotations while preserving next-token quality on held-out text.
physical_object: 6-layer, 8-head Pythia KV cache; each evaluation cache stores a 64-token prefix for both K and V
mirror_coordinate: Layer x head x K/V role ID selecting an exact 64D block-Hadamard/sign/permutation rotation from a small codebook
logical_multiplicity: Different quantization coordinate roles for each layer/head/KV tensor using shared physical rotation codes

quantization.rotation_order: apply per-block sign and permutation before the Hadamard transform; otherwise post-Hadamard signed permutations are quantizer symmetries and cannot alter error

calibration.split: four 64-token prefixes sampled from WikiText-2 train per development seed
calibration.objective: mean per-role relative K/V cache reconstruction error across calibration prefixes
calibration.selection: greedy four-code fit then per-role nearest candidate assignment; held-out text is not used

evaluation.metric: mean next-token NLL after one query token using the quantized cached prefix; report NLL delta versus FP16 and int4 identity

development.selection_metric: NLL delta, actual serialized one-session cache bytes, cache encode/decode time, online view operation proxy

controls: independent best-of-16 code per layer/head/KV role

storage.authority: actual serialized one-session inference cache payload bytes
paid_objects: all packed int4 K/V cache values for the 64-token prefix
selected rotation code arrays or codebook
cache shape, dtype, method and schema metadata

success_gate: Both dev seeds: codebook-4 NLL delta <=0.05 nat/token versus FP16 and >=0.01 nat/token better than identity int4; NLL no more than 0.02 nat/token worse than independent best-of-16; serialized cache bytes <=0.90x independent; no exact native codebook alias.
failure_gate: Any quality/storage miss or exact native shared-codebook parameter/output alias.
boundaries: Prefix KV cache is quantized; the one-token query cache is not retained or quantized
Evaluation is next-token NLL for one query after a cached prefix, not full-sequence perplexity
CPU timing and operation proxy only; no optimized serving kernel or GPU latency claim
Fresh test.txt windows stay sealed after any dev gate miss or exact native alias
